UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA

ALEXANDRIA DIVISION
MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE,
Plaintiff,
V. Case No. 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD
The Honorable Judge

Ivan D. Davis

KATIE HALL, individually;
NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN;
META PLATFORMS, INC.;
and JOHN/JANE DOES 1-6,

Defendants.

ORDER

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to Appear Remotely at the
September 25, 2026 Hearing. Upon consideration of the Motion, and for good cause shown, it is
hereby

ORDERED that the Motion is GRANTED; and it is further

ORDERED that Plaintiff may appear by videoconference or, if videoconference is
unavailable, by telephone at the hearing set for September 25, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. before the
undersigned; and it is further

ORDERED that the Clerk shall provide Plaintiff with connection information in advance of
the hearing.

Alexandria, Virginia
Date: , 2026

Ivan D. Davis
United States Magistrate Judge
